# users

Generate user mapping file from source to target environment

## Usage

```
ppds data users [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--analyze` |  | `bool` |  | Analyze user differences without generating mapping file |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Enable diagnostic logging output |
| `--output` | `-o` | `FileInfo` |  | Output user mapping XML file path |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--source-env` | `-se` | `string` |  | Source environment - accepts URL, friendly name, unique name, or ID |
| `--source-profile` | `-sp` | `string` |  | Authentication profile for source environment (defaults to active profile) |
| `--target-env` | `-te` | `string` |  | Target environment - accepts URL, friendly name, unique name, or ID |
| `--target-profile` | `-tp` | `string` |  | Authentication profile for target environment (defaults to active profile) |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Enable verbose logging output |
